model: FS SMSCSX fiber patch cable, 1 fiber, SC/UPC simplex to SC/APC simplex, OS2 9/125um, 2.0mm, riser (OFNR)
note: The reference part for the issue #18 case: SC/UPC (flat, blue) on one end, SC/APC (8 degree, green) on the other, one factory assembly. FS datasheet states connector insertion loss SMF <=0.3 dB, return loss UPC >=50 dB / APC >=60 dB. Stocked 1/2/3 m (SKU 96103/96104/96105), custom lengths to order (96106).

model: 3M singlemode patch cord SC/UPC-SC/APC, A2/B2 bend-insensitive, simplex, OFNR, 1.6mm jacket, yellow, 3 m
note: Same family in 1/3/5/10 m: ADAEP-ARYL001/003/005/010. 3M quotes attenuation 0.3 dB per connector typical singlmode and reflection -45 dB SC/UPC, -65 dB SC/APC typical. Typical rather than max, so budget the ceiling from another vendor if you need a worst case.

model: Siemon XGLO singlemode SC UPC to SC APC yellow simplex jumper, riser (OFNR), 3 m
note: Order code (XX) sets length: 01/02/03/05/10 m; use P for riser, H for LSOH (FJ1-SCUSCAL-03H). Siemon publishes max insertion loss 0.40 dB (0.15 typical APC, 0.10 typical UPC) and min return loss 65 dB APC / 55 dB UPC. One of the few vendors that publishes a max rather than a typical.

model: L-com SC/APC to SC/UPC 9/125um singlemode simplex fiber patch cable, riser, OS2, 2 m
note: L-com lists the part APC-end-first (A = APC, B = UPC); the engine ignores argument order, so hybridCord('sc-upc','sc-apc') finds it either way. Whole FCA-S2SR family is 01M/02M/03M/05M/10M/15M. L-com's assembly datasheets state insertion loss 0.3 dB max and return loss >=60 dB on APC builds / >=50 dB on UPC builds; the SKU page states only that each assembly is 100% tested for insertion loss.

model: CommScope OCJ fiber optic patch cord, simplex, singlemode, SC/UPC to SC/APC, yellow, 5 m (base product code 2160363-5)
note: The one part here from a tier-1 OSP vendor, and the one whose loss is quoted as a grade rather than a number: CommScope builds OCJ against IEC 61755-1 Grade C as standard and Grade B on request. Grade C ceiling is 0.50 dB per connector and Grade B 0.25 dB, so the 0.5 above is the standard-grade ceiling, not a measured figure. OCJ lengths run 1-30 m. Supplier part number is the base code 2160363-5; OCJ-S1-05MASIA-S2 is the orderable suffix.

model: FS SMLCSX fiber patch cable, 1 fiber, LC/UPC simplex to LC/APC simplex, OS2 9/125um, 2.0mm, riser (OFNR)
note: LC equivalent of SMSCSX, for SFP/SFP+ PON ports (some OLT and ONT modules are LC) meeting an APC ODN. Same <=0.3 dB connector IL, UPC >=50 dB / APC >=60 dB return loss, stocked 1/2/3 m, longer to order.

model: Siemon XGLO singlemode LC APC to LC UPC yellow simplex jumper, riser (OFNR), 3 m
note: Siemon catalogue spells the hybrid LC code LCALCUL (APC end first). Riser P, LSOH H, lengths 01/02/03/05/10 m. Same 0.40 dB max / 65 dB APC, 55 dB UPC return loss as the SC version.

model: FS SMLCDX fiber patch cable, 2 fibers, LC/UPC duplex to LC/APC duplex, OS2 9/125um, 2.0mm, riser (OFNR)
note: Duplex hybrid: both fibres carry one UPC end and one APC end, so a Tx/Rx pair crosses the polish change together and polarity stays straight-through. 1 m is SKU 177395, 2 m 151409, 3 m 151410, custom 151417. Charge the loss per fibre, not per cord.

model: L-com LC/APC to LC/UPC duplex 9/125um singlemode OS2 LSZH fiber patch cable, 5 m
note: SKU pattern FCA-LALU-DPS2Z-<len>: LA = LC/APC, LU = LC/UPC, D = duplex, P2 = 2.0mm, Z = LSZH (P = plenum). The same family in 1/2/3/10/15 m. Useful where a duplex LC PON uplink meets an APC patch field.

model: Panduit Opti-Core 2 fiber OS2, SC/APC duplex to SC/UPC duplex, 3mm jacket, riser (OFNR), 1 m
note: Panduit product page lists Connector 1 SC-APC Duplex and Connector 2 SC Duplex (SC with no polish letter is UPC in Panduit's scheme), 2 fibers, 3.0mm riser. Panduit Opti-Core standard IL is 0.50 dB max per connector for SC OS2 (0.25 dB for LC OS2), so this is the worst of the SC hybrids here - worth knowing before it lands in a 28 dB budget.

model: L-com SC/APC to LC/UPC duplex 9/125um singlemode OS2 OFNP fiber patch cable, 2 m
note: Shape hybrid AND polish hybrid: SC/APC on one end, LC/UPC on the other. Catalogue it because it is a real purchasable assembly, but polishBridge is false: a cord cannot convert a 2.5mm ferrule to a 1.25mm one, and the engine models that as E_CONNECTOR_MISMATCH, not as a polish bridge. The field answer is an LC pass-through panel and two cords.

model: Corning Basic 2.0mm 1 fiber patch cord, SMF-28 Ultra, single-mode, CPR Dca, LC APC simplex to SC UPC simplex, 7 m
note: Corning's per-connector spec sheet is the most complete of the set: insertion loss max 0.25 dB at both ends, reflectance <=-60 dB APC and <=-45 dB UPC, 500/1000 remating durability, CPR Dca jacket. Shape hybrid again (LC APC to SC UPC), so polishBridge is false and the engine will not use it to rescue a mismatch. Corning's part number encodes both ends and the length, so variants are separate orderable numbers.

model: Tripp Lite duplex singlemode 9/125 fiber patch cable, LC/UPC to SC/APC, 2 m (6 ft)
note: LC/UPC (blue) to SC/APC (green) duplex, 2 m, 0.30 dB insertion loss on the datasheet. Shape hybrid, so catalogued but polishBridge false. Good example of why the part number suffix matters: N366-02M is the UPC/UPC version of the same cable.
